hardware.variant: One assembled kit with operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2.

inputs.name: ESP_MOSAICO_LITTLEFS_NOR kernel #31 FIT
inputs.revision: Written at firmware offset 0x20000; esptool write verification passed; ordinary POWER boot used this image.

inputs.name: LittleFS root image
inputs.revision: 10 MiB at offset 0x600000; esptool write verification passed; mounted as flash1 on ordinary boot.

inputs.name: Connected-scan and roam readiness checker
inputs.revision: EmberBSD OS main commit a71f8001b4103f3e736695f459052f246473b91a; verifies IPv4 from the selected interface rather than optional wpa_cli status output.

inputs.name: Strict SAE profile
inputs.revision: PMF required locally; profile identifiers and credentials omitted.

scenario: On one operator-reported V1.2 sample after ordinary NOR boot, run one bounded strict-SAE baseline, connected scan and explicit roam to a fresh compatible alternate, then check association and basic IP connectivity.
expected: Baseline and scan remain associated; the accepted roam completes on the requested alternate; post-roam IPv4, DNS and gateway reachability succeed.
observed: The combined FIT and 10 MiB root writes passed esptool's built-in verification; SPL was left unchanged. An ordinary POWER boot selected ESP_MOSAICO_LITTLEFS_NOR kernel #31 and mounted the LittleFS root from flash1. Baseline status was WPA_COMPLETED with SAE and PMF=1. The connected scan did not interrupt that association. The selected alternate BSSID matched the final BSSID and differed from the baseline. After roam, status was WPA_COMPLETED with SAE and PMF=1; IPv4 was present in ifconfig, DNS resolution and gateway ping succeeded. Host getaddrinfo resolved the assigned .local name to one IPv4 address matching the target interface address. In a separate temporary WPA2-PSK profile trial, the selected network reached WPA2-PSK/COMPLETED and a host ping succeeded. The helper restored the saved-profile configuration; a subsequent router-side read-only association view showed WPA3-PSK with PMF on the original AP.

measurements.name: spl-unchanged
measurements.unit: combined update wrote FIT and root ranges only

measurements.name: ordinary-nor-boot
measurements.unit: ESP_MOSAICO_LITTLEFS_NOR kernel #31; root mounted from flash1

measurements.name: connected-scan-preserved-association
measurements.unit: baseline association remained active through scan

measurements.name: requested-alternate-matched-final-bssid
measurements.unit: requested and final BSSID matched; final differed from baseline

measurements.name: post-roam-host-mdns-name-resolution
measurements.unit: host getaddrinfo returned one IPv4 matching target ifconfig

measurements.name: temporary-wpa2-profile-connection-reported
measurements.unit: temporary profile helper reported connected; host ping succeeded

limits: One operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2 sample and one bounded strict-SAE roam run; this does not establish repeated-roam reliability or support for other revisions.

The temporary WPA2-PSK profile reached COMPLETED and host ping succeeded; this does not establish WPA2 autostart or repeated WPA2 reliability. Router-side association later showed WPA3-PSK/PMF restored on the original AP.

The current ESP management adapter advertises connected scan but does not forward general AUTH/ACTION management frames; RRM/BTM integration is not implemented. The router observer showed no 802.11k/v markers for this client, so AP-initiated BTM/802.11v and 802.11r were not tested. Forged-frame protection, throughput and sustained reliability remain unvalidated.
